messages:
Maria: quick Q — I have an x-request-id from a customer (abc123). I see a trace id in the tracing UI but console logs aren't linking it for me. Where's the fastest place to get raw HTTP request/response lines across LB -> edge -> worker? @Sam ?

Sam: start with the Traces UI — open the trace id, expand spans and look for proxy/app span attributes. The span usually has http.request_id or x_request_id in attributes. Once you have the request id you can jump to Logs explorer. Quick queries that work: 
- Logs explorer: `json.payload.x_request_id:"abc123" OR labels.request_id:abc123`
- If you prefer the terminal: `stern worker -n prod | rg "abc123"` or `kubectl logs -l app=worker -n prod --tail=200 | rg "abc123"`

Sam: also check the ingress (lb) logs, sometimes the header is renamed: try `rg "abc123"` in the edge/ingress pod logs.

Jo: if the Console collapses fields for you, use the trace -> span -> "view attributes" and copy the header name. Edge sometimes rewrites x-request-id to x-rw-id so try both. For Console Logs search UI I usually do: `Search > Logs > query: labels.x_request_id:abc123` and then switch to raw view.

ops-bot: heads-up: logs ingestion backlog ~10–15m for prod region right now, some very fresh requests might not show up immediately :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Lee: small tip — if you only have trace id but not request header, open trace, find the first proxy span and copy span.trace_id then in logs explorer filter `span_id:` or search for the trace id string — sometimes proxies log trace ids. Also try searching for `http.request_id` and `http.headers.x-request-id` alternates.

Maria: tried stern and found the worker pod logs with the payload, thanks all :tada: — got the request/response. Closing thread.
